note: Water and tide (docs/07). Meters, seconds, Y-up, mean sea level 0. The live simulation is visual only and runs on real seconds; the tide is analytic and read at display time for the look and at world time for the hourly tick.

tide.note: level(t) = A(t) cos(2 pi t / periodH + phase), A(t) = amplitudeM (1 + springNeap cos(4 pi moonPhase)). phaseH shifts high water in game hours.

sim.note: Virtual pipe model (O'Brien and Hodgins 1995; Mei et al. 2007) on 0.5 m cells. stepS: fixed step in real seconds per tier; maxSteps per frame. friction: c_f per second; thinFriction adds drag on sheets under thinDepthM so thin films stop sliding. maxSpeed clamps velocity. manningN: Manning roughness of the ground (0.03 smooth earth channel, 0.05 grass); it caps flow speed by depth and slope, so thin water runs slowly and stays visible. dryDepthM: below this a cell counts as dry.
sim.prefillNote: At start, hollows deeper than prefillMinDepthM and larger than prefillMinAreaM2 begin full to their lip (until the water summary arrives in S4b). The starter spring lives in the land recipe.

summary.note: The deterministic water summary (docs/07): integers only, rebuilt after terrain edits and spring changes, read by ecology and used as the live refill target. pondMinCatchmentM2 and pondMinDepthM: a dry hollow becomes a rain-fed pond when at least this much ground drains into it and it is at least this deep at its deepest; other hollows stay damp. Spring-fed hollows always fill. Stream depth d = clamp(streamK Q^streamExp, streamMinM, streamMaxM) with Q in L/s, capped by Manning depth for the local slope (manningN) over width w = streamW0 + streamW1 sqrt(Q). Classes by speed: still under slowSpeed, slow under runningSpeed, running above. debounceS after a stroke before rebuilding.

nudge.note: Live water is topped up toward the summary target, never drained by it: d += (target - d)(1 - exp(-dt / tauS)) where d < target. Ponds refill and dug hollows that count as ponds fill to their lip in about a minute.

tools.note: Pour and drain (water tool) add or remove water under the brush at up to rateLps at full strength. Springs: up to maxSprings placed by the player (sandbox now, the dragonflies' gift in normal play), each at one of the rates (L/s).

look.note: Water optics (docs/07). absorption: sigma_a per meter (Beer-Lambert) for sea and ponds; scatterAlbedo: single-scatter albedo of the water body; f0: Fresnel at normal incidence (n = 1.333); refraction: screen offset per unit normal tilt; edgeFadeM: where the water plane meets the bank, it fades in over this much water thickness (the last half cell toward a dry bank fades too); coherentDepthM: water thinner than the first value is a broken, rough film (grass and stones stand through it, reflection weak), reaching a full mirror-like surface by the second; waves: detail normal layers (wavelength m, strength, speed m/s); sea: Gerstner waves on open water (wavelength m, amplitude m, direction deg), faded out in water shallower than seaFadeDepthM.
look.dampHollowNote: How wet the summary's damp hollows look (0 dry, 1 as soaked as a stream bank); hollows smaller than dampHollowMinM2 stay plain.

riffle.note: White water on fast, shallow flow: fades in over the speed range (m/s), gone in water deeper than depthM; coverage is the share of the surface that is white at full strength; streakM the streak size; albedo of the aerated water.
